reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.comment: I set a new system up and the board works except for one big thing ... Intel RAID does not recognize the three SSDs onboard although both the BIOS and Windows 11 shows them. So, after six calls and chats with tech support there was no help or solution. No one at ASUS seems to have any idea what the issue is, but the board is of no use until the RAID is fixed. Finally I found a setting in BIOS that none of the Level 1 or Level 2 techs knew about that mapped the drives.
reviews.author: BrossyG

reviews.title: Niche board but perfect for those who need it.
reviews.comment: Though this platform (1851) may not be an exact workstation platform… this motherboard does bridge the gap in the market for those that are looking for server(ish) features, but not needing ecc memory or the ultra high core count from actual workstation boards (such as theeadripper). The board is high quality (as far as build and “feel”) but it does have an A-typical layout so be ready to get creative with cable management (if you are putting in a traditional Atx case).
reviews.author: Jakob

reviews.title: RAM slots soldered crooked from the factory
reviews.comment: 2 RAM slots soldered crooked from the factory.  After noticing this I noticed there were other components on the board that were also crooked, including the CPU_12V connectors as well as the PSUSMB connector.  Waiting on replacement board.
reviews.author: celo
